sar.narrative: On 2016-11-22 at 16:11, card C13487-K1 held by customer C13487 was used for one transaction of $74.96. The activity was online, billed in region(s) 191.0, under product code(s) C. The online transactions came from device profile(s) SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. The alert was raised by analyst request on transaction 3478561. The investigation found a pattern outside the bank's five documented typologies. Identity record device status 'New'; profile seen earlier on this card. Proxy flag (id_23) = 'IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS'. The same device profile was used on 27 other customers' cards within 30 days, including C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, indicating a common actor. It is suspicious because activity connects to a shared device profile used on other customers' cards (R2, R6, §3a); pattern is coordinated/undocumented (R9, §3a). Actions: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
